title: wt/start command payload leaks cmd metacharacters and breaks tab launch
description: When a batch launcher passes a pwsh -Command string through cmd or wt without strict quoting, cmd can consume pipe, semicolon, or ampersand tokens before PowerShell receives them. This causes false command-not-found failures and can corrupt batch control flow.
detection_method: Regex scan for AddTab style batch launch lines that embed pwsh -Command payloads containing cmd metacharacters
preventionRule: For wt/cmd launchers, avoid shell metacharacters in forwarded pwsh payloads. Prefer pwsh -File scripts, or wrap a single quoted -Command payload that cmd cannot parse into operators.
remedy: Replace inline pipeline command payloads with a script file or a metachar-safe command sequence. Example: avoid '| Format-List' in cmd-forwarded payloads; emit object directly or move formatting into a .ps1 file.
